name: Becoming Aria
source:
You are asked by you current girlfriend Scarlett to dress up like a girl and go bar hopping with her brother. However, you have no idea that Scarlett is a witch and she puts a spell on you, depending on the choices you make. Each decision you make will affect what type girl you become: Stripper, Cat Girl, Bimbo, Coed and more, but there is only one path back to your manhood!

[Edited from [url=https://tfgamessite.com/?module=viewgame&id=1379]TF Games Site[/url]]
